deterministic_precondition: Chief reported PRE_REVIEW_VERIFICATION: 990 PASS / 1 missing scientific decision output; semantics independently supplied and author stopped. This partial review does not cover the absent output.
read_scope: Both complete MD proposals, both JSON rule/gap registries and all 29 witness inputs/reconciled facts/interpretations/action bounds; current AEC/AEOS normative constraints. No raw provider assumption used as sports fact.
conditions: G03 conformance is only against explicitly declared semantic dimensions; it is not physiological adherence, safe dose, achieved stimulus or earned progression.
Recipe-specific sporting tolerance, measurement suitability and freshness remain OPEN_BY_RECIPE unless another independently reviewed exact record supplies them.
G04 nonclinical boundary approval permits a policy review, never a re-entry dose from days, historic training, absence of supplied concerns or low dose alone.
Clinical cases remain OUT_OF_SCOPE_CLINICAL / CLINICAL_HUMAN_REQUIRED; this review accepts the routing oracle and supplies no clinical judgment.
Synthetic fixture inputs are explicit testing premises, not observed athlete data, empirical product validation or proof that a runtime catalog exists.
Real data/integration/legal/clinical activation and runtime proof remain outside this partial gate.

item_dispositions.reason: Known declared set/repetition/load/reported-RIR/rest conformance does not assert technique or achieved stimulus.
Accepted prestart reduction changes the comparison target while preserving original history; no original achievement is granted.
Explicit stopped/omitted third set permits known-partial classification, not incapacity, fatigue cause or makeup debt.
Unreported third set plus provider completed label leaves coverage unknown and dependent adherence unclassified.
Verified mirrored origin/retry contributes one running exposure; three transports do not create three runs.
Two confirmed distinct runs remain two; distance sum is descriptive and not a fatigue conversion.
Unresolved one-versus-two identity cannot support a total, average canonical dose or deletion-as-zero.
Scoped 60-to-50kg correction replaces previous load once, changes dimensional comparison and preserves the previous fact frontier.
Late superseded revision is not a new physiological fact and cannot re-trigger adaptation.
Pretravel sleep report cannot establish current postchange readiness; no universal age-in-hours or compulsory missing-metric hold is introduced.
Missing per-hand/total convention blocks load comparison while known repetition facts remain usable.
Future calibration cannot rewrite adherence to the target method actually used; subjective effort does not certify physiological threshold.
Discordant effort/pace/HR without valid precedence/context remains a vector/conflict, not averaged readiness or diagnosed fatigue.
Postsession RPE is not interval RPE; completed structure cannot supply missing interval intensity.
Actual 3x7min work versus 3x6min is +180s work and 2400s total; fact comparison alone does not justify dose adaptation or extra merit.
Completed set1 retains r1; future sets accepted under r2 compare to r2; valid lineage does not approve sporting sufficiency.
Observed3000m and projected2000m are separate; no8000m double counting or5000m completion assertion.
Muscle/systemic/interaction projections reference one3-set exposure, not independent doses.
Opaque newer source does not override unresolved correction precedence; replay cannot revive suppressed exposure.
Declared9-day travel only establishes eligibility for a bounded review; re-entry recipe/dose remains held.
28-day agenda pause with lost slots establishes logistical horizon-review need; sporting partial-replan sufficiency remains a separate gate.
Unknown current eligibility requires the minimum question/hold and does not infer disease or grant a fallback dose.
Silent sync gap cannot establish interruption, detraining, debt or clinical referral.
Known relevant context change makes old eligibility information inadequate for current dependent prescription without inventing expiry days.
Missing/revoked recipe authority holds the recipe, not the whole person; low dose does not repair authority.
KEEP only follows explicitly assumed independently approved adequacy preconditions, not a single poor-sleep fact or absent clinical concern.
Fresh comparable converging signals justify review, while no amount/spacing change is approved without its own rule.
Persistent knee pain with functional limitation remains clinical human required; no reduced-run or rehab workaround.
Current illness/clearance request after start holds dependent remainder and preserves prefix; favourable device score grants no clearance.

invalidated_by: Any material target change requires affected partial review to be renewed; full gate requires integrated freeze and current checks.
